getter:CallToolResult.structuredContent.rationale: The 2026 revision deliberately widens structuredContent from an object to any JSON value; exact selected-schema validation remains the authority for each record.

getter:ToolResultContent.structuredConte.rationale: The 2026 revision deliberately widens structuredContent from an object to any JSON value; the shared getter must represent both validated wire contracts.

kind:ClientNotification:union->object.rationale: The canonical name changes from a 2025 aggregate union to a 2026 object, so separate Contract and Record symbols preserve both kinds with exact revision availability.

kind:ClientResult:union->alias.rationale: The canonical name changes from a 2025 aggregate union to a 2026 object alias, so separate Contract and Record symbols preserve both kinds with exact revision availability.
